summary.text: Neal Dunn was first elected to the U.S. House in 2016 and represents Florida's 2nd Congressional District; he is Vice Chair of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: He earned an undergraduate degree at Washington and Lee University and a medical degree at George Washington University, then served 15 years as an Army surgeon, completing his residency at Walter Reed Army Medical Center.
He practiced urology in Bay County, Florida, for 25 years, and he and his wife, Leah, live in Panama City.
